observations: Substantially matches reference geometry: chunky open C eyes, cropped half-lids, rounded uneven dashes, filled thought-eye silhouettes with cutout pupils.
All ten requested emotional roles present in order; listening mouth is closed; quiet thought looks upward rather than angry.
Deadpan and Delighted intentionally remain mouthless; Sad includes one tear on viewer's right.
No typography, icons, device frames, borders, or neighboring-cell overlap.
Uniform dark near-black background with subtle cyan glow.
limitations: Static concepts, not animation or lip-sync frames.
Background and cyan cores contain faint generated tonal variation rather than pixel-exact solid fills.
Calm and Listening share open C-eye construction; their eye scale/pose and mouths differentiate them.
